WITH target_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.id AS section_id,
           s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause,
           s.release AS target_release, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM cr_pack AS p
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.pack_id = p.id
    JOIN document AS d ON d.id = ip.cr
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id AND s.release = d.target_release
    WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-250620'
      AND d.target_release IN ('Rel-19')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disposition AS v
          JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
          JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
          WHERE v.target = d.id
            AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
            AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
            AND m.wg = 'RAN4'
      )
),
earlier_packs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.section_id AS section_id,
           t.specification AS specification, t.clause AS clause,
           hp.pack_number AS cr_pack, hp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting,
           hp.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM target_clauses AS t
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS hm ON hm.section_id = t.section_id
    JOIN document AS hd ON hd.id = hm.cr AND hd.target_release = t.target_release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS hip ON hip.cr = hd.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS hp ON hp.id = hip.pack_id
    WHERE hp.tsg_number < t.tsg_number
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.document AS document,
       t.specification AS specification, t.clause AS clause
FROM target_clauses AS t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM earlier_packs AS e
    WHERE e.section_id = t.section_id
